verdict.rationale: Asana lists an Asana widget for Figma and FigJam that turns ideas into next steps (tasks) from inside the design tool, plus live Figma embeds. A Canva integration and a third-party connector covering Figma, Sketch and Adobe are also listed. However, the evidence only shows creating tasks and sharing designs; it never shows updating task or project status from within the design tool. Missing for 10: documented ability to update task or project status from inside Figma or other design tools, in-depth docs for the widget, independent or hands-on corroboration.
